# Prime IV Hydration & Wellness

> Doctor-supervised IV hydration, vitamin drips, NAD+, and wellness injections in Jones Valley, Huntsville, Alabama. Owned by Ann Van Steenburgh, RN, and John Van Steenburgh.

The clinic is at 2626 Carl T. Jones Drive, Suite B, Huntsville, AL 35802. Call (256) 678-0033, text (256) 993-3095, or email jonesvalley@primeivhydration.com. Hours: Sunday 10 AM–5 PM, Monday 9 AM–3 PM, Tuesday 10 AM–7 PM, Wednesday 9 AM–6 PM, Thursday 10 AM–7 PM, Friday 9 AM–6 PM, Saturday 9 AM–5 PM. New clients complete a one-time $25 telehealth screening. A first VIP IV visit is $85 with code VIPIVHUNTSVILLEAL.

## Services

- [IV therapy](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/iv-therapy): Energy, recovery, immunity, beauty, and NAD+ drips
- [Full menu](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/menu): Primary drips, specialty drips, injections, and premium infusions
- [IV drip matcher](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/iv-matcher): Match a concern to a Prime IV drip
- [Myers' Cocktail](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/myers-iv-therapy): The classic vitamin IV
- [NAD+ and Niagen](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/nad-niagen-special): Cellular-energy infusions and Niagen therapy
- [Memberships](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/memberships): Monthly IV plans
- [IV packs](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/iv-packs): Prepaid 6-IV and 12-IV packs with no monthly fee
- [Specials](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/specials): Current promotions
- [Gift cards](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/gift-cards): IV therapy gift cards in any amount
- [Medical weight management](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/medical-weight-loss): Provider-guided weight management with IV support
- [Corporate team wellness](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/corporate-team-wellness): Private team mornings with IVs, breakfast, and massage chairs
- [Bridal hydration](https://www.huntsvilleiv.com/bridal-glow-starts-with-hydration): The Glow IV for brides and bridal parties
